Pillow broad faces top/bottom, opposite end/sides. Plant upright canopy top, pot base bottom. Chest broad panels front/rear, narrow sides, footprint top/bottom. Rug patterned TOP, plain-backed BOTTOM, four very thin edge elevations. Bookcase upright shelves front/back, narrow sides, caps top/bottom. Pixel-art style, crisp clusters, warm source palette, no smooth repaint. Critical: each object at most 60% of its cell width and height, >=20% transparent margin on every side, no part may touch or cross any cell boundary. No labels, gridlines, dividers, shadows, backdrop or scenery.
